source.text: וַיְהִ֣י הַגּוֹרָ֗ל לְמַטֵּ֛ה בְּנֵ֥י יְהוּדָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם אֶל־גְּב֨וּל אֱד֧וֹם מִדְבַּר־צִ֛ן נֶ֖גְבָּה מִקְצֵ֥ה תֵימָֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And was the lot for [the] tribe of [the] sons of Judah by their clans to [the] border of Edom, [the] wilderness of Zin southward, at [the] end of [the] south.

en.L: And the lot for the tribe of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah by their clans was to the border of Edom, the wilderness of Zin southward, at the end of the south.
en.B: The land that fell by lot to the tribe of Judah, clan by clan, reached south to the border of Edom and the wilderness of Zin, at the far southern end.
en.R: This is the land that the tribe of Judah received by lot for its clans. In the south it reached the border of Edom and the Zin Desert, at the land's farthest southern point.

sw.L: Na kura ya kabila la wana wa Yuda kufuatana na koo zao ilikuwa hadi mpaka wa Edomu, nyika ya Zini kuelekea kusini, mwisho wa kusini.
sw.B: Nchi iliyoangukia kabila la Yuda kwa kura, ukoo kwa ukoo, ilifika kusini hadi mpaka wa Edomu na nyika ya Zini, upande wa mwisho wa kusini.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo nchi ambayo kabila la Yuda lilipokea kwa kura kwa ajili ya koo zake. Upande wa kusini ilifika mpaka wa Edomu na Jangwa la Zini, sehemu ya mwisho kabisa ya kusini.

es.L: Y la suerte para la tribu de los hijos de Judá conforme a sus clanes fue hacia la frontera de Edom, el desierto de Zin al sur, en el extremo del sur.
es.B: La tierra que le tocó por suerte a la tribu de Judá, clan por clan, llegaba al sur hasta la frontera de Edom y el desierto de Zin, en el extremo sur.
es.R: Esta es la tierra que la tribu de Judá recibió por sorteo para sus clanes. Por el sur llegaba hasta la frontera de Edom y el desierto de Zin, en el punto más al sur de la tierra.

fr.L: Et le sort pour la tribu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda, selon leurs clans, fut vers la frontière d’Édom, le désert de Tsin vers le sud, à l’extrémité du midi.
fr.B: Le territoire échu par le sort à la tribu de Juda, clan par clan, s’étendait au sud jusqu’à la frontière d’Édom et au désert de Tsin, à l’extrémité sud.
fr.R: Voici le pays que la tribu de Juda a reçu par tirage au sort pour ses clans. Au sud, il allait jusqu’à la frontière d’Édom et au désert de Tsin, à l’extrémité sud du pays.

vi.L: Thăm cho chi tộc con cháu Giu-đa theo các gia tộc của họ là [phần đất] đến ranh giới Ê-đôm, đồng hoang Xin về phía nam, ở tận cùng phía nam.
vi.B: Phần đất bắt thăm được cho chi tộc Giu-đa, theo từng gia tộc, chạy về phía nam đến ranh giới Ê-đôm và đồng hoang Xin, ở tận cùng phía nam.
vi.R: Đây là phần đất chi tộc Giu-đa bắt thăm được cho các gia tộc của mình. Ở phía nam, đất ấy chạy đến ranh giới Ê-đôm và hoang mạc Xin, là điểm xa nhất về phía nam của xứ.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 자손 지파의 그들의 종족대로의 제비[로 뽑힌 땅]은 에돔 경계, 곧 남쪽의 신 광야, 남쪽 끝까지였다.
ko.B: 유다 지파가 종족별로 제비 뽑아 받은 땅은 남쪽으로 에돔 경계와 신 광야에 이르러, 남쪽 맨 끝까지 닿았다.
ko.R: 유다 지파가 집안별로 제비를 뽑아 받은 땅은 이러하다. 그 땅은 남쪽으로 에돔 경계와 신 광야까지, 곧 그 땅의 가장 남쪽 끝까지 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a sorte para a tribo dos filhos de Judá, segundo os seus clãs, foi até a fronteira de Edom, o deserto de Zim, para o sul, na extremidade do sul.
pt.B: A terra que coube por sorteio à tribo de Judá, clã por clã, chegava ao sul até a fronteira de Edom e o deserto de Zim, no extremo sul.
pt.R: Esta é a terra que a tribo de Judá recebeu por sorteio para os seus clãs. No sul, ela chegava até a fronteira de Edom e o deserto de Zim, no ponto mais ao sul da terra.

decisions.choice: the lot: the share of land given by casting lots
decisions.reason: The land west of the Jordan was shared out by lot, so that the LORD, not the leaders, decided which tribe received which region (14:1-2; Numbers 26:55-56; 34:13). Judah's share is described first: its borders (verses 1-12), Caleb's portion (verses 13-19) and its towns (verses 20-63).

decisions.choice: was to the border of Edom: its share reached as far as Edom
decisions.reason: The verse names the southern limit of Judah's land: Edom's border and the wilderness of Zin, the same southern line that Numbers 34:3 gives for the whole land. Verses 2-4 then trace it in detail.

decisions.choice: The land that fell by lot (B); received by lot (R); the tribe of Judah
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "the lot ... was to the border of Edom", meaning the land the lot gave. Balanced and Readable say so. Literal keeps "children of Judah"; Balanced and Readable say "the tribe of Judah", since the tribe is meant.

decisions.choice: the Zin Desert
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:3.

decisions.choice: "la frontera" for the boundary line, at every level
decisions.reason: For Joshua 13-24: the Hebrew word names both a boundary and the land inside it. Where it is the line itself, as through these lists, Spanish says "la frontera" and lets it run, go up, turn and end, as the Hebrew does; where it is the land inside, Spanish says "el territorio".

decisions.choice: the border descriptions in the present at Literal and Balanced ("monte", "passe", "tourne"), in the past at Readable ("montait", "passait")
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal and Balanced describe the line as it runs on the ground, in the present; Readable tells it as part of the story, in the imperfect, the French tense for a lasting state in the past. The pattern holds for the borders of chapters 15-19.

decisions.choice: "thăm" (Literal); "bắt thăm được" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The lot is the means by which each share was decided; Literal keeps the bare noun as the Hebrew does, and the other levels say the land "fell by lot", as the English does.

decisions.choice: "đồng hoang" (Literal, Balanced); "hoang mạc" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wilderness is dry, empty land, not always sand; "hoang mạc" is the plainer word for a young reader.

decisions.choice: a sorte (L); coube por sorteio (B); recebeu por sorteio (R); os filhos de Judá (L), a tribo de Judá (B, R), no gender setting
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Judá
decisions.reason: For chapters 15-17: as Numbers 34:13 sets it in Portuguese, Literal keeps "a sorte", the old word for the lot and for the share it gives (m1), and Balanced and Readable say "por sorteio", which a modern reader cannot take for luck; "caber" is the Portuguese verb for what falls to someone as a share (Numbers 34:2). "Os filhos de Judá" needs no gender setting where the English has one: "filhos" already includes daughters, as Joshua 1:2 sets for the whole book.

source.text: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ גְּב֣וּל נֶ֔גֶב מִקְצֵ֖ה יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֑לַח מִן־הַלָּשֹׁ֖ן הַפֹּנֶ֥ה נֶֽגְבָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was for them [the] border [of the] south from [the] end of [the] Sea of the Salt, from the tongue that faces southward.

en.L: And their southern border was from the end of the Salt Sea, from the tongue that faces southward.
en.B: Their southern border ran from the end of the Dead Sea, from the bay that faces south.
en.R: Their southern border began at the southern end of the Dead Sea, at the inlet that points south.

sw.L: Na mpaka wao wa kusini ulikuwa kutoka mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi, kutoka ulimi unaoelekea kusini.
sw.B: Mpaka wao wa kusini ulianzia mwisho wa Bahari ya Chumvi, kwenye ghuba inayoelekea kusini.
sw.R: Mpaka wao wa kusini ulianzia ncha ya kusini ya Bahari Mfu, kwenye hori inayoelekea kusini.

es.L: Y su frontera del sur fue desde el extremo del mar Salado, desde la lengua que mira hacia el sur.
es.B: Su frontera sur iba desde el extremo del mar Muerto, desde la bahía que mira al sur.
es.R: Su frontera sur empezaba en el extremo sur del mar Muerto, en la ensenada que apunta hacia el sur.

fr.L: Et leur frontière du sud fut depuis l’extrémité de la mer Salée, depuis la langue qui fait face au sud.
fr.B: Leur frontière sud partait de l’extrémité de la mer Morte, de la baie qui regarde vers le sud.
fr.R: Leur frontière sud commençait à l’extrémité sud de la mer Morte, à la pointe qui s’avance vers le sud.

vi.L: Ranh giới phía nam của họ là từ cuối Biển Muối, từ cái lưỡi hướng về phía nam.
vi.B: Ranh giới phía nam của họ chạy từ cuối Biển Chết, từ vịnh hướng về phía nam.
vi.R: Ranh giới phía nam của họ bắt đầu ở đầu phía nam Biển Chết, tại cái vũng nhô về phía nam.

ko.L: 그리고 그들의 남쪽 경계는 염해 끝, 곧 남쪽을 향한 혀[처럼 나온 곳]에서부터였다.
ko.B: 그들의 남쪽 경계는 사해 끝, 곧 남쪽으로 향한 만에서부터 시작되었다.
ko.R: 그들의 남쪽 경계는 사해의 남쪽 끝, 곧 남쪽으로 쑥 들어간 물굽이에서 시작되었다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sul deles era desde a extremidade do mar Salgado, desde a língua que se volta para o sul.
pt.B: A fronteira sul deles começava na extremidade do mar Morto, na baía que se volta para o sul.
pt.R: A fronteira sul deles começava na ponta sul do mar Morto, na enseada que aponta para o sul.

decisions.choice: the Salt Sea: the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: The Salt Sea is the Dead Sea, as in Numbers 34:3 and Genesis 14:3. The southern border starts at its southern end.

decisions.choice: the tongue: a bay or inlet of the sea
decisions.reason: "Tongue" is used for a strip of water reaching into the land (Isaiah 11:15). Here it is the shallow southern end of the Dead Sea, which points south; verse 5 uses the same word for the bay at its northern end.

decisions.choice: Salt Sea (L), Dead Sea (B, R); tongue (L), bay (B), inlet (R)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:3, Balanced and Readable use the modern name of the sea. Literal keeps the picture of the "tongue"; Balanced and Readable say what it is.

decisions.choice: "Bahari ya Chumvi" (Literal, Balanced), "Bahari Mfu" (Readable), as Deuteronomy 3:17; "ulimi" (Literal), "ghuba" (Balanced), "hori" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As Deuteronomy 3:17 in Swahili: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name "Salt Sea", Readable uses the modern name. The "tongue" of the sea is a bay or inlet at its southern end.

decisions.choice: "el mar Salado" and "la lengua" (L); "el mar Muerto" with "la bahía" (B) or "la ensenada" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew names, the Salt Sea and its "tongue"; Balanced and Readable use the name Spanish readers know, "el mar Muerto", and plain words for the inlet, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "la mer Salée" (L), "la mer Morte" (B, R); "la langue" (L), "la baie" (B), "la pointe" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the Hebrew name and picture, Balanced and Readable use the names and words a French reader knows.

decisions.choice: "Biển Muối" (Literal); "Biển Chết" (Balanced, Readable); "lưỡi" (L), "vịnh" (B), "vũng" (R) for the tongue of the sea
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew name and picture; the other levels use the name readers know today, as the English does.

Literal keeps the Hebrew names, "Salt Sea" and "tongue"; Balanced and Readable give the sea its usual name and say what the "tongue" is, a bay (meaning decisions m1 and m2), as the English does. The same holds in verse 5.

decisions.choice: o mar Salgado (L), o mar Morto (B, R); a língua (L), a baía (B), a enseada (R)
decisions.reason: The sea keeps the Portuguese of Numbers 34:3 and Joshua 3:16 (m1). Literal keeps the picture of the "tongue" (m2): Portuguese also speaks of a "língua" of land or water reaching out; Balanced and Readable say what it is, "a baía" and the plainer "a enseada", as the English does (r-en-1).

source.text: וְ֠יָצָא אֶל־מִנֶּ֜גֶב לְמַעֲלֵ֤ה עַקְרַבִּים֙ וְעָ֣בַר צִ֔נָה וְעָלָ֥ה מִנֶּ֖גֶב לְקָדֵ֣שׁ בַּרְנֵ֑עַ וְעָבַ֤ר חֶצְרוֹן֙ וְעָלָ֣ה אַדָּ֔רָה וְנָסַ֖ב הַקַּרְקָֽעָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes out to from [the] south to [the] ascent of Akrabbim, and passes on to Zin, and goes up from [the] south to Kadesh-barnea, and passes on [to] Hezron, and goes up to Addar, and turns to the Karka,

en.L: And it goes out south of the ascent of Akrabbim, and passes on to Zin, and goes up south of Kadesh-barnea, and passes on to Hezron, and goes up to Addar, and turns to Karka,
en.B: It goes out south of the Ascent of Akrabbim, passes along to Zin, goes up south of Kadesh-barnea, passes Hezron, goes up to Addar and turns toward Karka,
en.R: From there it went south of Scorpion Pass and on to Zin. Then it went up south of Kadesh-barnea, past Hezron and up to Addar, and turned toward Karka.

sw.L: Na unatokea kusini mwa mwinuko wa Akrabimu, na kupita hadi Zini, na kupanda kusini mwa Kadesh-barnea, na kupita hadi Hesroni, na kupanda hadi Adari, na kugeuka kuelekea Karka,
sw.B: Unatokea kusini mwa Mwinuko wa Akrabimu, unapita hadi Zini, unapanda kusini mwa Kadesh-barnea, unapita Hesroni, unapanda hadi Adari na kugeuka kuelekea Karka,
sw.R: Kutoka hapo ulipita kusini mwa Kipito cha Nge, ukaendelea hadi Zini. Kisha ukapanda kusini mwa Kadesh-barnea, ukapita Hesroni na kupanda hadi Adari, ukageuka kuelekea Karka.

es.L: Y sale al sur de la subida de Acrabim, y pasa a Zin, y sube al sur de Cades-barnea, y pasa a Hezrón, y sube a Adar, y gira hacia Carca,
es.B: Sale al sur de la subida de Acrabim, pasa por Zin, sube al sur de Cades-barnea, pasa por Hezrón, sube a Adar y gira hacia Carca,
es.R: Desde allí iba al sur del paso del Escorpión y seguía hasta Zin. Luego subía al sur de Cades-barnea, pasaba por Hezrón, subía hasta Adar y giraba hacia Carca.

fr.L: Et elle sort au sud de la montée d’Akrabbim, et passe vers Tsin, et monte au sud de Kadesh-Barnéa, et passe vers Hetsron, et monte vers Addar, et tourne vers Karka,
fr.B: Elle sort au sud de la montée d’Akrabbim, passe vers Tsin, monte au sud de Kadesh-Barnéa, passe par Hetsron, monte vers Addar et tourne vers Karka,
fr.R: De là, elle passait au sud du col des Scorpions et allait jusqu’à Tsin. Ensuite, elle montait au sud de Kadesh-Barnéa, passait par Hetsron, montait jusqu’à Addar et tournait vers Karka.

vi.L: Nó đi ra phía nam dốc Ạc-ráp-bim, đi qua Xin, đi lên phía nam Ca-đe-Ba-nê-a, đi qua Hết-rôn, đi lên Át-đa, và vòng về Cạt-ca,
vi.B: Ranh giới đi ra phía nam dốc Ạc-ráp-bim, chạy dọc qua Xin, đi lên phía nam Ca-đe-Ba-nê-a, qua Hết-rôn, lên Át-đa rồi vòng về phía Cạt-ca,
vi.R: Từ đó ranh giới đi về phía nam đèo Bọ Cạp và tiếp đến Xin. Rồi nó đi lên phía nam Ca-đe-Ba-nê-a, qua Hết-rôn, lên Át-đa, và vòng về phía Cạt-ca.

ko.L: 그리고 그것은 아그랍빔 비탈 남쪽으로 나가서 신으로 지나가고, 가데스 바네아 남쪽으로 올라가서 헤스론으로 지나가고, 아달로 올라가서 갈가로 돌아가고,
ko.B: 경계는 아그랍빔 고개 남쪽으로 나가서 신을 지나고, 가데스 바네아 남쪽으로 올라가서 헤스론을 지나고, 아달로 올라가서 갈가 쪽으로 돌아,
ko.R: 거기에서 경계는 전갈 고개 남쪽을 지나 신까지 갔다. 그리고 가데스 바네아 남쪽으로 올라가서 헤스론을 지나 아달로 올라간 다음 갈가 쪽으로 돌았다.

pt.L: E sai ao sul da subida de Acrabim, e passa por Zim, e sobe ao sul de Cades-Barneia, e passa por Hezrom, e sobe até Adar, e dá a volta até Carca,
pt.B: Segue ao sul da Subida de Acrabim, passa por Zim, sobe ao sul de Cades-Barneia, passa por Hezrom, sobe até Adar e vira em direção a Carca,
pt.R: Dali ela seguia ao sul da Subida dos Escorpiões e ia até Zim. Depois subia ao sul de Cades-Barneia, passava por Hezrom, subia até Adar e virava em direção a Carca.

decisions.choice: went out, passed on, went up: the course of the line
decisions.reason: The verbs trace the border from one landmark to the next, as if walking along it. They describe how the line runs on the ground, as in Numbers 34:4-5.

decisions.choice: the ascent of Akrabbim: the Scorpions' Pass
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:4: a road climbing steeply up from the desert south-west of the Dead Sea.

decisions.choice: Hezron, Addar, Karka: places on the southern edge
decisions.reason: Numbers 34:4 has Hazar-addar where this verse names Hezron and Addar, perhaps two settlements near one another. Karka is named only here. None of the three sites is known for certain.

decisions.choice: the Ascent of Akrabbim (B); Scorpion Pass (R)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:4.

decisions.choice: goes out ... turns (L, B); went ... turned (R)
decisions.reason: The border is traced with a chain of verbs in a form that describes how a line regularly runs. Literal and Balanced use the present tense for it, as through the boundary lists of chapters 15-19 (18:12). Readable tells the line in the past tense, as part of the story of the lot; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: "Kipito cha Nge" (Scorpion Pass)
decisions.reason: Akrabbim means "scorpions". Readable translates the name, as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep "Akrabimu".

decisions.choice: "la subida de Acrabim" (L, B); "el paso del Escorpión" (R)
decisions.reason: The name means "ascent of scorpions"; Literal and Balanced keep it as a name, Readable translates it, as the English Readable says "Scorpion Pass". Readable tells the boundary in the past ("iba", "giraba"), as the English Readable does; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew present.

decisions.choice: "le col des Scorpions" at Readable for the Ascent of Akrabbim
decisions.reason: Akrabbim means "scorpions". Readable translates the name, as the English "Scorpion Pass" does; Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name.

decisions.choice: "아그랍빔 비탈" (L); "아그랍빔 고개" (B); "전갈 고개" (R)
decisions.reason: The name means "ascent of scorpions" (meaning decision m2). Literal and Balanced keep the name; Readable says what it means, as the English Readable says "Scorpion Pass". Readable tells the boundary in the past, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "đèo Bọ Cạp" at Readable; "dốc Ạc-ráp-bim" at Literal and Balanced
decisions.reason: Akrabbim means "scorpions"; Readable gives the meaning of the name, as the English "Scorpion Pass" does.

decisions.choice: a fronteira sobe, desce, passa por, sai (L) / segue (B), dá a volta (L) / vira (B), se estende (L) / faz uma curva (B), o seu extremo é em (L) / termina em (B), in the present; subia, descia, passava por, seguia, virava, fazia uma curva, terminava em (R), in the imperfect
alternatives: the pretérito perfeito (saiu, passou, subiu) at Readable
decisions.reason: For the whole book's boundary lists (chapters 15-19), as 18:12 also has it. The verbs trace how the line runs on the ground, a standing fact rather than events (m1). Literal and Balanced describe it in the present, as the English does (r-en-2); Readable tells it in the past, as the English Readable does, but in the imperfect, the Portuguese tense for describing how something lay, since the perfeito "subiu" would make the border move like a traveller. Each Hebrew verb keeps one Portuguese verb wherever it comes: "subir", "descer", "passar por", "sair" (L; "seguir" at B and R), "dar a volta" (L; "virar" at B and R) for the turn, and "estender-se" (L; "fazer uma curva" at B and R) for the verb of verse 9, as in 18:14. Where a line runs out at the sea or the Jordan, Literal says "o seu extremo é em", as Numbers 34:4-5 says "o seu extremo" in Portuguese, and Balanced and Readable "termina em" / "terminava em".

decisions.choice: a subida de Acrabim (L), a Subida de Acrabim (B), a Subida dos Escorpiões (R); Cades-Barneia; Hezrom, Adar, Carca
decisions.reason: The pass and Cades-Barneia keep the Portuguese of Numbers 34:4 (m2). Hezrom, Adar and Carca are written by the same pattern ("c" for k, a final -on "-om"); none of the three sites is known (m3).

source.text: וְעָבַ֣ר עַצְמ֗וֹנָה וְיָצָא֙ נַ֣חַל מִצְרַ֔יִם וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָ֑מָּה זֶה־יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם גְּב֥וּל נֶֽגֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: and passes on [to] Azmon, and goes out [to the] wadi of Egypt, and are [the] ends of the border at [the] sea. This will be for you [the] border [of the] south.

en.L: and passes on to Azmon, and goes out to the brook of Egypt; and the end of the border is at the sea. This will be your southern border.
en.B: passes Azmon, and goes out to the Wadi of Egypt, ending at the sea. This will be your southern border.
en.R: It passed Azmon and went to the Wadi of Egypt, a stream that is dry most of the year. It ended at the Mediterranean Sea. This will be your southern border.

sw.L: na kupita hadi Azmoni, na kutokea kijito cha Misri; na mwisho wa mpaka ni baharini. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu wa kusini.
sw.B: unapita Azmoni, na kutokea Bonde la Misri, ukiishia baharini. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu wa kusini.
sw.R: Ulipita Azmoni, ukaenda hadi Bonde la Misri, mkondo ambao huwa mkavu karibu mwaka mzima. Uliishia Bahari ya Mediterania. Huu utakuwa mpaka wenu wa kusini.

es.L: y pasa a Azmón, y sale al torrente de Egipto; y los extremos de la frontera están en el mar. Esta será {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} frontera del sur.
es.B: pasa por Azmón y sale al torrente de Egipto, y termina en el mar. Esta será {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} frontera sur.
es.R: Pasaba por Azmón y llegaba al torrente de Egipto, un arroyo que está seco casi todo el año. Terminaba en el mar Mediterráneo. Esta será {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} frontera sur.

fr.L: et passe vers Atsmon, et sort vers le torrent d’Égypte ; et les extrémités de la frontière sont à la mer. Ce sera votre frontière du sud.
fr.B: passe par Atsmon et sort au torrent d’Égypte, pour aboutir à la mer. Ce sera votre frontière sud.
fr.R: Elle passait par Atsmon et allait jusqu’au torrent d’Égypte, un cours d’eau à sec la plus grande partie de l’année. Elle se terminait à la mer Méditerranée. Ce sera votre frontière sud.

vi.L: đi qua Át-môn, và đi ra đến suối Ai Cập; và cuối ranh giới là ở biển. Đây sẽ là ranh giới phía nam của các ngươi.
vi.B: qua Át-môn rồi đi ra đến khe Ai Cập và dừng lại ở biển. Đây sẽ là ranh giới phía nam của các ngươi.
vi.R: Nó đi qua Át-môn đến khe Ai Cập, một dòng suối khô cạn gần như quanh năm, rồi dừng lại ở Địa Trung Hải. Đây sẽ là ranh giới phía nam của các ngươi.

ko.L: 아스몬으로 지나가서 이집트 시내로 나가고, 그 경계의 끝은 바다였다. 이것이 너희의 남쪽 경계가 될 것이다.
ko.B: 아스몬을 지나 이집트 시내로 나가서 바다에서 끝난다. 이것이 너희의 남쪽 경계가 될 것이다.
ko.R: 경계는 아스몬을 지나 이집트 시내까지 갔다. 그 시내는 한 해의 대부분 말라 있는 시냇바닥이다. 경계는 지중해에서 끝났다. 이것이 너희의 남쪽 경계가 될 것이다.

pt.L: e passa por Azmom, e sai até o ribeiro do Egito; e o extremo da fronteira é no mar. Esta será a fronteira sul de vocês.
pt.B: passa por Azmom, segue até o ribeiro do Egito e termina no mar. Esta será a fronteira sul de vocês.
pt.R: Ela passava por Azmom e seguia até o ribeiro do Egito, um riacho que fica seco a maior parte do ano. Terminava no mar Mediterrâneo. Esta será a fronteira sul de vocês.

decisions.choice: the wadi of Egypt: the stream bed between Canaan and Egypt
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:5. It lay in the desert of northern Sinai and marked the edge of Canaan toward Egypt (verse 47).

decisions.choice: this will be your southern border: the words of the command repeated
decisions.reason: The sentence speaks to Israel as "you", in the words the LORD gave Moses for the borders of the whole land (Numbers 34:3-6). The writer quotes the command to show that Judah's southern border is the border promised there. The ancient Greek translation reads "their southern border".

decisions.choice: they are: the reading the scribes marked
decisions.reason: The consonants written in the text read "it is"; the reading the scribes marked to be read, followed here, is "they are", agreeing with the plural "ends". The meaning is the same, as in Numbers 34:4.

decisions.choice: brook (L), Wadi (B, R); the Mediterranean Sea (R)
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:5. Readable explains the wadi and names the sea.

decisions.choice: "kijito cha Misri" (Literal); "Bonde la Misri" (Balanced, Readable); "Bahari ya Mediterania" (Readable)
decisions.reason: A wadi is a stream bed that fills only in the rainy season. Literal says "kijito" (brook), the other levels "bonde" (valley), as the English moves from "brook" to "Wadi". Readable names the sea the reader knows.

decisions.choice: "su frontera" by default, "vuestra frontera" with the plural-you setting
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "for you" is plural, the words of the boundary list as spoken to the people (as in Numbers 34:3). Spanish must choose a plural form: "su" (the ustedes form) by default, "vuestra" with the plural-you setting.

decisions.choice: "le torrent d'Égypte" at every level
decisions.reason: As for the Arnon (13:9), "torrent" is the French word for a stream that runs in winter and dries in summer; it serves at every level, where the English has "brook" at Literal and "Wadi" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "이집트 시내"; "지중해" (R)
decisions.reason: The wadi of Egypt is a stream bed that runs only after rain (meaning decision m1); "시내" fits it better than "강" (river). Readable says what it is and names the Mediterranean, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "của các ngươi" at every level for "your"
decisions.reason: The sentence keeps the words of the LORD's command to Moses (Numbers 34:3-6), so "your" is the LORD speaking to Israel as a nation, which keeps "các ngươi" at every level (1:2).

decisions.choice: Esta será a fronteira sul de vocês (every level)
alternatives: Esta era a fronteira sul deles
decisions.reason: The sentence quotes the LORD's command to Moses (m2), so every level keeps its future and its plural "vocês" in the Portuguese of Numbers 34:3, "a fronteira sul de vocês", although the verbs around it describe the line. "O ribeiro do Egito" is Numbers 34:5's term at every level.

source.text: וּגְב֥וּל קֵ֨דְמָה֙ יָ֣ם הַמֶּ֔לַח עַד־קְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן וּגְב֞וּל לִפְאַ֤ת צָפ֨וֹנָה֙ מִלְּשׁ֣וֹן הַיָּ֔ם מִקְצֵ֖ה הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] border eastward [is] the Sea of the Salt to [the] end of the Jordan. And [the] border on [the] side northward [is] from [the] tongue of the sea, from [the] end of the Jordan.

en.L: And the eastern border [is] the Salt Sea, as far as the end of the Jordan. And the border on the north side [is] from the tongue of the sea, at the end of the Jordan.
en.B: On the east, the Dead Sea forms the border, up to the mouth of the Jordan. On the north side the border begins at the bay where the Jordan enters the sea.
en.R: On the east, the border was the Dead Sea, all the way up to where the Jordan River flows into it. The northern border began at the bay at the north end of the Dead Sea, where the Jordan flows in.

sw.L: Na mpaka wa mashariki [ni] Bahari ya Chumvi, hadi mwisho wa Yordani. Na mpaka wa upande wa kaskazini [ni] kutoka ulimi wa bahari, mwisho wa Yordani.
sw.B: Upande wa mashariki, Bahari ya Chumvi ndiyo mpaka, hadi mdomo wa Yordani. Upande wa kaskazini mpaka unaanzia kwenye ghuba ambapo Yordani inaingia baharini.
sw.R: Upande wa mashariki, mpaka ulikuwa Bahari Mfu, hadi pale Mto Yordani unapoingia ndani yake. Mpaka wa kaskazini ulianzia kwenye hori iliyo upande wa kaskazini wa Bahari Mfu, pale Yordani unapoingia.

es.L: Y la frontera del oriente [es] el mar Salado, hasta el extremo del Jordán. Y la frontera del lado norte [va] desde la lengua del mar, en el extremo del Jordán.
es.B: Al oriente, el mar Muerto forma la frontera, hasta la desembocadura del Jordán. Por el lado norte, la frontera empieza en la bahía donde el Jordán entra en el mar.
es.R: Por el este, la frontera era el mar Muerto, hasta donde el río Jordán desemboca en él. La frontera norte empezaba en la bahía del extremo norte del mar Muerto, donde entra el Jordán.

fr.L: Et la frontière à l’orient [est] la mer Salée, jusqu’à l’extrémité du Jourdain. Et la frontière du côté du nord [part] de la langue de mer, à l’extrémité du Jourdain.
fr.B: À l’est, la mer Morte forme la frontière jusqu’à l’embouchure du Jourdain. Au nord, la frontière part de la baie où le Jourdain se jette dans la mer.
fr.R: À l’est, la frontière était la mer Morte, jusqu’à l’endroit où le Jourdain s’y jette. La frontière nord commençait à la baie, au nord de la mer Morte, là où arrive le Jourdain.

vi.L: Ranh giới phía đông [là] Biển Muối, cho đến cuối sông Giô-đanh. Ranh giới ở phía bắc [là] từ lưỡi biển, ở cuối sông Giô-đanh.
vi.B: Ở phía đông, Biển Chết làm ranh giới, cho đến cửa sông Giô-đanh. Ở phía bắc, ranh giới bắt đầu từ vịnh nơi sông Giô-đanh đổ vào biển.
vi.R: Ở phía đông, ranh giới là Biển Chết, lên đến chỗ sông Giô-đanh đổ vào biển. Ranh giới phía bắc bắt đầu từ cái vũng ở đầu phía bắc Biển Chết, nơi sông Giô-đanh đổ vào.

ko.L: 그리고 동쪽 경계는 요단 끝까지 염해[이다]. 그리고 북쪽 편 경계는 요단 끝에 있는 바다의 혀에서부터[이다].
ko.B: 동쪽 경계는 요단강 어귀까지 사해이다. 북쪽 경계는 요단강이 바다로 들어가는 만에서 시작된다.
ko.R: 동쪽 경계는 사해였는데, 요단강이 사해로 흘러드는 곳까지였다. 북쪽 경계는 사해 북쪽 끝, 요단강이 흘러드는 물굽이에서 시작되었다.

pt.L: E a fronteira oriental [era] o mar Salgado, até a extremidade do Jordão. E a fronteira do lado norte [era] desde a língua do mar, desde a extremidade do Jordão.
pt.B: A leste, a fronteira é o mar Morto, até a foz do Jordão. Do lado norte, a fronteira começa na baía onde o Jordão entra no mar.
pt.R: No leste, a fronteira era o mar Morto, até o lugar onde o rio Jordão deságua nele. A fronteira norte começava na baía do extremo norte do mar Morto, onde o Jordão deságua.

decisions.choice: the end of the Jordan: where the river flows into the sea
decisions.reason: The "end" of the river is its mouth, the place where it empties into the Dead Sea. The whole western shore of the sea is Judah's eastern border.

decisions.choice: the tongue of the sea: the bay at the northern end
decisions.reason: The same word as in verse 2, here for the bay at the north end of the Dead Sea, where the Jordan comes in. The northern border starts from there and runs west (verses 6-11).
The Hebrew sets the border beside the place without a verb. Literal supplies "is" in brackets.

decisions.choice: the mouth of the Jordan (B); where the Jordan River flows into it (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the "end" of the river is (m1). Literal keeps "end".

source.text: וְעָלָ֤ה הַגְּבוּל֙ בֵּ֣ית חָגְלָ֔ה וְעָבַ֕ר מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְבֵ֣ית הָעֲרָבָ֑ה וְעָלָ֣ה הַגְּב֔וּל אֶ֥בֶן בֹּ֖הַן בֶּן־רְאוּבֵֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes up the border [to] Beth-hoglah, and passes on from [the] north of Beth-arabah, and goes up the border [to the] stone of Bohan son of Reuben.

en.L: And the border goes up to Beth-hoglah, and passes on north of Beth-arabah; and the border goes up to the stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
en.B: The border goes up to Beth-hoglah and passes north of Beth-arabah, then goes up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
en.R: From there it went up to Beth-hoglah and passed north of Beth-arabah. Then it went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben, a rock that served as a landmark.

sw.L: Na mpaka unapanda hadi Beth-hogla, na kupita kaskazini mwa Beth-araba; na mpaka unapanda hadi jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.
sw.B: Mpaka unapanda hadi Beth-hogla na kupita kaskazini mwa Beth-araba, kisha unapanda hadi Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni.
sw.R: Kutoka hapo ulipanda hadi Beth-hogla, ukapita kaskazini mwa Beth-araba. Kisha ukapanda hadi Jiwe la Bohani mwana wa Reubeni, mwamba uliotumika kama alama ya mpaka.

es.L: Y sube la frontera a Bet-hogla, y pasa al norte de Bet-arabá; y sube la frontera a la piedra de Bohán hijo de Rubén.
es.B: La frontera sube a Bet-hogla y pasa al norte de Bet-arabá; luego sube a la Piedra de Bohán hijo de Rubén.
es.R: Desde allí subía a Bet-hogla y pasaba al norte de Bet-arabá. Luego subía hasta la Piedra de Bohán hijo de Rubén, una roca que servía de señal.

fr.L: Et la frontière monte vers Beth-Hogla, et passe au nord de Beth-Araba ; et la frontière monte vers la pierre de Bohan, fils de Ruben.
fr.B: La frontière monte vers Beth-Hogla et passe au nord de Beth-Araba, puis elle monte jusqu’à la Pierre de Bohan, fils de Ruben.
fr.R: De là, elle montait vers Beth-Hogla et passait au nord de Beth-Araba. Ensuite, elle montait jusqu’à la Pierre de Bohan, fils de Ruben, un rocher qui servait de repère.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi lên Bết-Hốt-la, đi qua phía bắc Bết-A-ra-ba; và ranh giới đi lên đến hòn đá của Bô-han con trai Ru-bên.
vi.B: Ranh giới đi lên Bết-Hốt-la, qua phía bắc Bết-A-ra-ba, rồi lên đến Đá Bô-han con trai Ru-bên.
vi.R: Từ đó ranh giới đi lên Bết-Hốt-la và qua phía bắc Bết-A-ra-ba. Rồi nó đi lên Đá Bô-han con trai Ru-bên, một tảng đá dùng làm mốc.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 벧호글라로 올라가서 벧아라바 북쪽으로 지나가고, 경계는 르우벤의 아들 보한의 돌로 올라간다.
ko.B: 경계는 벧호글라로 올라가서 벧아라바 북쪽을 지나, 르우벤의 아들 보한의 돌까지 올라간다.
ko.R: 거기에서 경계는 벧호글라로 올라가서 벧아라바 북쪽을 지났다. 그리고 르우벤의 아들 보한의 돌까지 올라갔다. 그 돌은 경계를 알려 주는 표지였다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sobe até Bete-Hogla, e passa ao norte de Bete-Arabá; e a fronteira sobe até a pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.
pt.B: A fronteira sobe até Bete-Hogla e passa ao norte de Bete-Arabá; depois sobe até a Pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben.
pt.R: Dali ela subia até Bete-Hogla e passava ao norte de Bete-Arabá. Depois subia até a Pedra de Boã, filho de Rúben, uma rocha que servia de marco.

decisions.choice: Beth-hoglah and Beth-arabah: places in the Jordan valley
decisions.reason: Both lay in the valley near Jericho, between the river and the hills. The same line is the southern border of Benjamin (18:19-22), and Beth-arabah is counted among Judah's towns in verse 61 and among Benjamin's in 18:22.

decisions.choice: the stone of Bohan son of Reuben: a known landmark
decisions.reason: The stone is named only here and in 18:17. Why it bore the name of a man from the tribe of Reuben is not told; it was a rock well known enough to mark the line.

decisions.choice: a rock that served as a landmark
decisions.reason: Readable says why a stone is named in a border list (m2).

decisions.choice: Bete-Hogla, Bete-Arabá; a pedra (L), a Pedra (B, R) de Boã
decisions.reason: The names follow the Brazilian pattern for "Beth-" names set at 7:2 ("Bete-Áven"). The stone is a known landmark (m2), so Balanced and Readable capitalise it as a name, as 18:17 does; Literal keeps the common noun.

source.text: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֥וּל׀דְּבִרָה֮ מֵעֵ֣מֶק עָכוֹר֒ וְצָפ֜וֹנָה פֹּנֶ֣ה אֶל־הַגִּלְגָּ֗ל אֲשֶׁר־נֹ֨כַח֙ לְמַעֲלֵ֣ה אֲדֻמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַנָּ֑חַל וְעָבַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־מֵי־עֵ֣ין שֶׁ֔מֶשׁ וְהָי֥וּ תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו אֶל־עֵ֥ין רֹגֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes up the border to Debir from [the] valley of Achor, and northward turning to the Gilgal which [is] opposite [the] ascent of Adummim, which [is] south of the wadi; and passes on the border to [the] waters of En-shemesh, and are its ends at En-rogel.

en.L: And the border goes up to Debir from the Valley of Achor, and turning northward to Gilgal, which [is] opposite the ascent of Adummim, which [is] south of the wadi; and the border passes on to the waters of En-shemesh, and its end is at En-rogel.
en.B: From the Valley of Achor the border goes up to Debir and turns north toward Gilgal, which faces the Ascent of Adummim, on the south side of the wadi. It goes on to the waters of En-shemesh and comes out at En-rogel.
en.R: From the Valley of Achor it went up to Debir and turned north toward Gilgal. Gilgal is across from the road that climbs to Adummim, south of the stream bed. Then the border went on to the springs of En-shemesh and reached En-rogel.

sw.L: Na mpaka unapanda hadi Debiri kutoka Bonde la Akori, na kugeuka kaskazini kuelekea Gilgali, ulio mkabala na mwinuko wa Adumimu, ulio kusini mwa korongo; na mpaka unapita hadi maji ya En-shemeshi, na mwisho wake ni En-rogeli.
sw.B: Kutoka Bonde la Akori mpaka unapanda hadi Debiri, na kugeuka kaskazini kuelekea Gilgali, unaoelekeana na Mwinuko wa Adumimu, upande wa kusini wa korongo. Unaendelea hadi maji ya En-shemeshi na kutokea En-rogeli.
sw.R: Kutoka Bonde la Akori ulipanda hadi Debiri, ukageuka kaskazini kuelekea Gilgali. Gilgali iko mkabala na njia inayopanda kwenda Adumimu, kusini mwa mkondo wa maji. Kisha mpaka ukaendelea hadi chemchemi za En-shemeshi, ukafika En-rogeli.

es.L: Y sube la frontera a Debir desde el valle de Acor, y al norte gira hacia Gilgal, que [está] frente a la subida de Adumín, que [está] al sur del torrente; y pasa la frontera a las aguas de En-semes, y sus extremos están en En-rogel.
es.B: Desde el valle de Acor la frontera sube a Debir y gira al norte hacia Gilgal, que está frente a la subida de Adumín, al sur del torrente. Sigue hasta las aguas de En-semes y sale a En-rogel.
es.R: Desde el valle de Acor subía a Debir y giraba al norte hacia Gilgal. Gilgal está frente al camino que sube a Adumín, al sur del cauce del arroyo. Luego la frontera seguía hasta los manantiales de En-semes y llegaba a En-rogel.

fr.L: Et la frontière monte vers Debir depuis la vallée d’Akor, et vers le nord, tournant vers Guilgal, qui [est] en face de la montée d’Adoummim, qui [est] au sud du torrent ; et la frontière passe vers les eaux d’En-Shémesh, et ses extrémités sont à En-Roguel.
fr.B: Depuis la vallée d’Akor, la frontière monte vers Debir et tourne au nord vers Guilgal, en face de la montée d’Adoummim, au sud du torrent. Elle passe ensuite vers les eaux d’En-Shémesh et aboutit à En-Roguel.
fr.R: Depuis la vallée d’Akor, elle montait jusqu’à Debir et tournait vers le nord, vers Guilgal. Guilgal est en face de la route qui monte vers Adoummim, au sud du ravin. Puis la frontière allait jusqu’aux sources d’En-Shémesh et arrivait à En-Roguel.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi lên Đê-bia từ thung lũng A-cô, và quay về phía bắc hướng Ghinh-ganh, [nơi] đối diện dốc A-đu-mim, ở phía nam khe; ranh giới đi qua đến các dòng nước Ên-Sê-mết, và cuối của nó là ở Ên-Rô-ghên.
vi.B: Từ thung lũng A-cô, ranh giới đi lên Đê-bia rồi quay về phía bắc hướng Ghinh-ganh, đối diện dốc A-đu-mim ở phía nam khe. Nó chạy đến các dòng nước Ên-Sê-mết và ra đến Ên-Rô-ghên.
vi.R: Từ thung lũng A-cô, ranh giới đi lên Đê-bia và quay về phía bắc hướng Ghinh-ganh. Ghinh-ganh nằm đối diện con đường dốc lên A-đu-mim, ở phía nam lòng suối. Rồi ranh giới đi tiếp đến các suối nước Ên-Sê-mết và đến Ên-Rô-ghên.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 아골 골짜기에서 드빌로 올라가고, 골짜기 남쪽에 있는 아둠밈 비탈 맞은편의 길갈을 향하여 북쪽으로 돌아가며, 경계는 엔세메스 물로 지나가고, 그 끝은 엔로겔이다.
ko.B: 경계는 아골 골짜기에서 드빌로 올라가서 북쪽으로 길갈을 향하여 도는데, 길갈은 골짜기 남쪽에 있는 아둠밈 고개 맞은편에 있다. 경계는 엔세메스 물로 지나가서 엔로겔에서 끝난다.
ko.R: 아골 골짜기에서 경계는 드빌로 올라간 다음 북쪽으로 길갈을 향하여 돌았다. 길갈은 아둠밈으로 올라가는 길 건너편, 시냇바닥 남쪽에 있다. 그런 다음 경계는 엔세메스 샘물을 지나 엔로겔에 이르렀다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sobe até Debir desde o vale de Acor, e para o norte, voltando-se para Gilgal, que [está] em frente à subida de Adumim, que [está] ao sul do ribeiro; e a fronteira passa pelas águas de En-Semes, e o seu extremo é em En-Rogel.
pt.B: Do vale de Acor a fronteira sobe até Debir e vira para o norte, em direção a Gilgal, que fica em frente à Subida de Adumim, do lado sul do ribeiro. Depois passa pelas águas de En-Semes e chega a En-Rogel.
pt.R: Do vale de Acor ela subia até Debir e virava para o norte, em direção a Gilgal. Gilgal fica em frente à estrada que sobe para Adumim, ao sul do leito do ribeiro. Depois a fronteira passava pelas fontes de En-Semes e chegava a En-Rogel.

decisions.choice: Debir and the Valley of Achor: places in the hills west of Jericho
decisions.reason: This Debir is a place on the northern border, not the town Caleb's family took (verse 15). The Valley of Achor is where Achan was put to death (7:24-26).

decisions.choice: Gilgal opposite the ascent of Adummim
decisions.reason: Adummim means "red places", probably from the color of the rocks; the ascent is the road climbing from the Jordan valley toward Jerusalem. This Gilgal faces it and may be the Geliloth of 18:17. It is not certainly the camp near Jericho (4:19).

decisions.choice: En-shemesh and En-rogel: springs east and south of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: En means "spring": En-shemesh is "spring of the sun", on the road east of Jerusalem. En-rogel was a spring in the valley just below the city, where David's messengers hid and Adonijah held his feast (2 Samuel 17:17; 1 Kings 1:9).

decisions.choice: the road that climbs to Adummim; the stream bed; the springs
decisions.reason: Readable says what the "ascent", the "wadi" and the "waters" are.

decisions.choice: "Guilgal" here as elsewhere, the form the block's terms note sets for Gilgal
decisions.reason: This Gilgal on Judah's border is a different place from Israel's camp near Jericho, but the Hebrew name is the same, and French keeps one spelling for it.

decisions.choice: o ribeiro (L, B), o leito do ribeiro (R); En-Semes, En-Rogel; chega a (B), chegava a (R)
alternatives: Fonte do Sol, Fonte de Rogel
decisions.reason: "Ribeiro" is the word Numbers 34:5 sets for a wadi, and Readable adds "o leito" for the dry stream bed, as the English says "stream bed". The springs keep "En-" joined to the name with a hyphen, as Portuguese writes "En-Gedi" (m3). Here the line runs on past En-Rogel (verse 8), so Balanced and Readable say "chega a" / "chegava a" rather than "termina em", which is kept for the end of a line.

source.text: וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל גֵּ֣י בֶן־הִנֹּ֗ם אֶל־כֶּ֤תֶף הַיְבוּסִי֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶב הִ֖יא יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם וְעָלָ֨ה הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֲ֠שֶׁר עַל־פְּנֵ֤י גֵֽי־הִנֹּם֙ יָ֔מָּה אֲשֶׁ֛ר בִּקְצֵ֥ה עֵֽמֶק־רְפָאִ֖ים צָפֹֽנָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes up the border [by the] valley of Ben-hinnom to [the] slope of the Jebusite from [the] south, that [is] Jerusalem; and goes up the border to [the] top of the mountain which [is] on [the] face of [the] valley of Hinnom westward, which [is] at [the] end of [the] valley of Rephaim northward.

en.L: And the border goes up by the Valley of Ben-hinnom to the slope of the Jebusite on the south, that [is] Jerusalem; and the border goes up to the top of the mountain that [is] facing the Valley of Hinnom westward, which [is] at the end of the Valley of Rephaim northward.
en.B: Then the border goes up the Valley of Ben-hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusite city, that is, Jerusalem. From there it goes up to the hilltop that looks across the Valley of Hinnom from the west, at the northern end of the Valley of Rephaim.
en.R: Next it went up the Valley of Ben-hinnom, along the south side of the hill where the Jebusites lived, that is, Jerusalem. Then it climbed to the top of the hill that looks across the Valley of Hinnom from the west. That hill is at the north end of the Valley of Rephaim.

sw.L: Na mpaka unapanda kwa Bonde la Ben-hinomu hadi mteremko wa Myebusi upande wa kusini, yaani Yerusalemu; na mpaka unapanda hadi kilele cha mlima ulio mkabala na Bonde la Hinomu upande wa magharibi, ulio mwisho wa Bonde la Refaimu upande wa kaskazini.
sw.B: Kisha mpaka unapanda Bonde la Ben-hinomu kando ya mteremko wa kusini wa mji wa Wayebusi, yaani Yerusalemu. Kutoka hapo unapanda hadi kilele cha kilima kinachotazamana na Bonde la Hinomu kutoka magharibi, upande wa kaskazini wa mwisho wa Bonde la Refaimu.
sw.R: Kisha ukapanda Bonde la Ben-hinomu, kando ya upande wa kusini wa kilima walichoishi Wayebusi, yaani Yerusalemu. Ukapanda hadi kilele cha kilima kinachotazamana na Bonde la Hinomu kutoka magharibi. Kilima hicho kiko upande wa kaskazini wa mwisho wa Bonde la Refaimu.

es.L: Y sube la frontera por el valle de Ben-hinom a la ladera del jebuseo por el sur, que [es] Jerusalén; y sube la frontera a la cumbre del monte que [está] frente al valle de Hinom al occidente, que [está] en el extremo del valle de Refaim al norte.
es.B: Luego la frontera sube por el valle de Ben-hinom, por la ladera sur de la ciudad jebusea, es decir, Jerusalén. De allí sube a la cumbre del monte que mira al valle de Hinom desde el occidente, en el extremo norte del valle de Refaim.
es.R: Después subía por el valle de Ben-hinom, por el lado sur de la colina donde vivían los jebuseos, es decir, Jerusalén. Luego subía a la cumbre de la colina que mira al valle de Hinom desde el oeste. Esa colina está en el extremo norte del valle de Refaim.

fr.L: Et la frontière monte par la vallée de Ben-Hinnom vers le flanc du Jébusien, au sud, c’[est] Jérusalem ; et la frontière monte vers le sommet de la montagne qui [est] en face de la vallée de Hinnom vers l’occident, qui [est] à l’extrémité de la vallée des Rephaïm vers le nord.
fr.B: Puis la frontière monte par la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, le long du versant sud de la ville jébusienne, c’est-à-dire Jérusalem. De là, elle monte au sommet de la colline qui fait face à la vallée de Hinnom à l’ouest, à l’extrémité nord de la vallée des Rephaïm.
fr.R: Ensuite, elle montait par la vallée de Ben-Hinnom, le long du côté sud de la colline où habitaient les Jébusiens, c’est-à-dire Jérusalem. Puis elle grimpait jusqu’au sommet de la colline qui fait face à la vallée de Hinnom, à l’ouest. Cette colline est à l’extrémité nord de la vallée des Rephaïm.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi lên theo thung lũng Bên-Hi-nôm đến sườn [đất] người Giê-bu-sít ở phía nam, tức là Giê-ru-sa-lem; và ranh giới đi lên đến đỉnh núi đối diện thung lũng Hi-nôm về phía tây, ở cuối thung lũng Rê-pha-im về phía bắc.
vi.B: Rồi ranh giới đi lên thung lũng Bên-Hi-nôm, dọc theo sườn phía nam của thành người Giê-bu-sít, tức là Giê-ru-sa-lem. Từ đó nó đi lên đỉnh đồi nhìn sang thung lũng Hi-nôm từ phía tây, ở đầu phía bắc thung lũng Rê-pha-im.
vi.R: Tiếp theo, nó đi lên thung lũng Bên-Hi-nôm, dọc theo phía nam ngọn đồi nơi người Giê-bu-sít ở, tức là Giê-ru-sa-lem. Rồi nó leo lên đỉnh ngọn đồi nhìn sang thung lũng Hi-nôm từ phía tây. Ngọn đồi ấy ở đầu phía bắc thung lũng Rê-pha-im.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 벤힌놈 골짜기를 따라 여부스 사람의 남쪽 비탈로 올라가니, 그것은 예루살렘이다. 그리고 경계는 서쪽으로 힌놈 골짜기를 마주하고 있는 산꼭대기로 올라가니, 그것은 북쪽으로 르바임 골짜기 끝에 있다.
ko.B: 그다음에 경계는 벤힌놈 골짜기로 올라가서 여부스 성읍, 곧 예루살렘의 남쪽 비탈을 따라간다. 거기에서 힌놈 골짜기를 서쪽에서 마주 보는 언덕 꼭대기로 올라가는데, 그 언덕은 르바임 골짜기의 북쪽 끝에 있다.
ko.R: 그다음에 경계는 벤힌놈 골짜기로 올라가서, 여부스 사람들이 살던 언덕, 곧 예루살렘의 남쪽을 따라갔다. 그리고 힌놈 골짜기를 서쪽에서 마주 보는 언덕 꼭대기로 올라갔다. 그 언덕은 르바임 골짜기의 북쪽 끝에 있다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sobe pelo vale de Ben-Hinom até a encosta do jebuseu, ao sul, que [é] Jerusalém; e a fronteira sobe até o topo do monte que [fica] em frente ao vale de Hinom, a oeste, que [está] na extremidade do vale de Refaim, ao norte.
pt.B: Depois a fronteira sobe pelo vale de Ben-Hinom, ao longo da encosta sul da cidade dos jebuseus, isto é, Jerusalém. Dali sobe até o alto da colina que fica em frente ao vale de Hinom, a oeste, na extremidade norte do vale de Refaim.
pt.R: Em seguida ela subia pelo vale de Ben-Hinom, ao longo do lado sul da colina onde viviam os jebuseus, isto é, Jerusalém. Depois subia até o alto da colina que fica em frente ao vale de Hinom, do lado oeste. Essa colina fica na extremidade norte do vale de Refaim.

decisions.choice: the slope of the Jebusite: the hillside of the Jebusite city
decisions.reason: "The Jebusite" stands for the people and their town, which is Jerusalem. "Slope" is literally "shoulder", the side of a hill (Numbers 34:11). The line runs along the south side of the city, so Jerusalem itself lies just outside Judah, in Benjamin (18:16, 28).

decisions.choice: the Valley of Ben-hinnom: "the valley of the son of Hinnom"
decisions.reason: The valley ran along the south and west of Jerusalem and was named after a man called Hinnom. It later became a place of child sacrifice and a byword for judgment (2 Kings 23:10; Jeremiah 7:31-32); its name, Ge-hinnom, is the source of Gehenna.

decisions.choice: the Valley of Rephaim: a broad valley south-west of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The name recalls the Rephaim, a people of great size who once lived in the land (Deuteronomy 2:11). The Philistines later camped there to attack David (2 Samuel 5:18, 22).

decisions.choice: the Jebusite city (B); the hill where the Jebusites lived (R); hill for "mountain"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "the Jebusite" means here (m1). The word for "mountain" is used for any high ground; around Jerusalem it is a hill.

decisions.choice: o jebuseu (L); a cidade dos jebuseus (B); a colina onde viviam os jebuseus (R); o monte (L), a colina (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew singular, "o jebuseu", for the people and their town (m1); Balanced and Readable say what it means, with the plural "os jebuseus" of 3:10. The word for "mountain" is any high ground, here a hill by Jerusalem, so Balanced and Readable say "colina", as the English says "hill" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: o vale de Ben-Hinom, o vale de Hinom, o vale de Refaim
decisions.reason: "Vale" lowercase before the name, as "o vale de Acor" (7:26). The valley keeps the place-name "Refaim" unchanged, while the people it recalls (m3) are "os refains" in Portuguese (Deuteronomy 2:11), so the name is not turned into the people.

source.text: וְתָאַ֨ר הַגְּב֜וּל מֵרֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֗ר אֶל־מַעְיַן֙ מֵ֣י נֶפְתּ֔וֹחַ וְיָצָ֖א אֶל־עָרֵ֣י הַר־עֶפְר֑וֹן וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ בַּעֲלָ֔ה הִ֖יא קִרְיַ֥ת יְעָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And turns the border from [the] top of the mountain to [the] spring of [the] waters of Nephtoah, and goes out to [the] cities of Mount Ephron; and turns the border [to] Baalah, that [is] Kiriath-jearim.

en.L: And the border is drawn from the top of the mountain to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, and goes out to the cities of Mount Ephron; and the border is drawn to Baalah, that [is] Kiriath-jearim.
en.B: From the top of the hill the border curves around to the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, goes out to the towns of Mount Ephron, and bends around to Baalah, that is, Kiriath-jearim.
en.R: From the top of that hill the border turned toward the spring called the Waters of Nephtoah and went out to the towns of Mount Ephron. Then it turned toward Baalah, which is also called Kiriath-jearim.

sw.L: Na mpaka unazunguka kutoka kilele cha mlima hadi chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa, na kutokea miji ya mlima Efroni; na mpaka unazunguka hadi Baala, yaani Kiriath-yearimu.
sw.B: Kutoka kilele cha kilima mpaka unazunguka hadi chemchemi ya maji ya Neftoa, unatokea kwenye miji ya Mlima Efroni, na kupinda kuelekea Baala, yaani Kiriath-yearimu.
sw.R: Kutoka kilele cha kilima hicho ulielekea chemchemi iitwayo Maji ya Neftoa, ukaenda hadi miji ya Mlima Efroni. Kisha ukageuka kuelekea Baala, ambao pia huitwa Kiriath-yearimu.

es.L: Y se traza la frontera desde la cumbre del monte hasta el manantial de las aguas de Neftoa, y sale a las ciudades del monte Efrón; y se traza la frontera hacia Baala, que [es] Quiriat-jearim.
es.B: Desde la cumbre del monte la frontera da la vuelta hasta el manantial de las aguas de Neftoa, sale a las poblaciones del monte Efrón y se curva hacia Baala, es decir, Quiriat-jearim.
es.R: Desde la cumbre de esa colina giraba hacia el manantial llamado Aguas de Neftoa y salía a los pueblos del monte Efrón. Luego giraba hacia Baala, que también se llama Quiriat-jearim.

fr.L: Et la frontière s’infléchit du sommet de la montagne vers la source des eaux de Nephtoah, et sort vers les villes du mont Éphron ; et la frontière s’infléchit vers Baala, c’[est] Kiryath-Yearim.
fr.B: Du sommet de la colline, la frontière s’incurve vers la source des eaux de Nephtoah, sort vers les villes du mont Éphron et s’incurve vers Baala, c’est-à-dire Kiryath-Yearim.
fr.R: Du sommet de cette colline, la frontière tournait vers la source appelée les Eaux de Nephtoah et allait jusqu’aux villes du mont Éphron. Puis elle tournait vers Baala, qu’on appelle aussi Kiryath-Yearim.

vi.L: Ranh giới kéo từ đỉnh núi đến nguồn nước Nép-thô-ách, đi ra đến các thành của núi Ép-rôn; và ranh giới kéo đến Ba-a-la, tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim.
vi.B: Từ đỉnh đồi ranh giới vòng đến nguồn nước Nép-thô-ách, đi ra đến các thị trấn của núi Ép-rôn, rồi uốn về Ba-a-la, tức là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim.
vi.R: Từ đỉnh đồi ấy ranh giới quay về phía con suối gọi là Nguồn Nước Nép-thô-ách và đi ra đến các thị trấn của núi Ép-rôn. Rồi nó quay về Ba-a-la, cũng gọi là Ki-ri-át Giê-a-rim.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 산꼭대기에서 넵도아 샘물로 이어지고 에브론 산의 성읍들로 나가며, 경계는 바알라, 곧 기럇여아림으로 이어진다.
ko.B: 경계는 그 언덕 꼭대기에서 넵도아 샘물로 굽어 돌아 에브론 산의 성읍들로 나가고, 바알라, 곧 기럇여아림으로 굽어 돈다.
ko.R: 그 언덕 꼭대기에서 경계는 넵도아 샘물이라고 하는 샘 쪽으로 돌아 에브론 산의 성읍들로 나갔다. 그리고 바알라 쪽으로 돌았는데, 바알라는 기럇여아림이라고도 한다.

pt.L: E a fronteira se estende desde o topo do monte até a fonte das águas de Neftoa, e sai até as cidades do monte Efrom; e a fronteira se estende até Baalá, que [é] Quiriate-Jearim.
pt.B: Do alto da colina a fronteira faz uma curva até a fonte das águas de Neftoa, segue até as cidades do monte Efrom e faz outra curva até Baalá, isto é, Quiriate-Jearim.
pt.R: Do alto daquela colina, a fronteira fazia uma curva em direção à fonte chamada Águas de Neftoa e seguia até as cidades do monte Efrom. Depois fazia uma curva em direção a Baalá, também chamada Quiriate-Jearim.

decisions.choice: the spring of the waters of Nephtoah; Mount Ephron
decisions.reason: A spring north-west of Jerusalem and a range of hills beyond it, named again on Benjamin's border (18:15). Their exact sites are not certain.

decisions.choice: Baalah, that is, Kiriath-jearim
decisions.reason: Kiriath-jearim, "town of forests", was one of the Gibeonite towns (9:17) and later the place where the ark stayed for twenty years (1 Samuel 7:1-2). Baalah, a name formed from Baal, was its older name; verse 60 calls it Kiriath-baal.

decisions.choice: towns
decisions.reason: The word for "city" is used of any walled place where people live, however small. Balanced and Readable say "towns"; Literal keeps "cities", as in Numbers 32:16.

decisions.choice: as cidades (every level)
decisions.reason: For chapters 15-17. The word is used of any walled place, however small (r-en-1). Portuguese "cidade" covers a small town as well as a large one, as in "as cidades de Judá", while "vila" would suggest a village, which the lists call by another word (verse 32). So every level says "cidades" where the English moves to "towns" at Balanced and Readable. Quiriate-Jearim keeps the form of 9:17.

source.text: וְנָסַב֩ הַגְּב֨וּל מִבַּעֲלָ֥ה יָ֨מָּה֙ אֶל־הַ֣ר שֵׂעִ֔יר וְעָבַ֕ר אֶל־כֶּ֧תֶף הַר־יְעָרִ֛ים מִצָּפ֖וֹנָה הִ֣יא כְסָל֑וֹן וְיָרַ֥ד בֵּֽית־שֶׁ֖מֶשׁ וְעָבַ֥ר תִּמְנָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And turns the border from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passes on to [the] slope of Mount Jearim from [the] north, that [is] Chesalon; and goes down [to] Beth-shemesh, and passes on [to] Timnah.

en.L: And the border turns from Baalah westward to Mount Seir, and passes on to the slope of Mount Jearim on the north, that [is] Chesalon; and goes down to Beth-shemesh, and passes on to Timnah.
en.B: From Baalah the border turns west to Mount Seir, passes along the northern slope of Mount Jearim, that is, Chesalon, then goes down to Beth-shemesh and on to Timnah.
en.R: From Baalah it turned west to Mount Seir. It went along the north side of Mount Jearim, that is, Chesalon. Then it went down to Beth-shemesh and on to Timnah.

sw.L: Na mpaka unageuka kutoka Baala kuelekea magharibi hadi mlima Seiri, na kupita hadi mteremko wa mlima Yearimu upande wa kaskazini, yaani Kesaloni; na kushuka hadi Beth-shemeshi, na kupita hadi Timna.
sw.B: Kutoka Baala mpaka unageuka kuelekea magharibi hadi Mlima Seiri, unapita kando ya mteremko wa kaskazini wa Mlima Yearimu, yaani Kesaloni, kisha unashuka hadi Beth-shemeshi na kuendelea hadi Timna.
sw.R: Kutoka Baala ulielekea magharibi hadi Mlima Seiri. Ulipita upande wa kaskazini wa Mlima Yearimu, yaani Kesaloni. Kisha ukashuka hadi Beth-shemeshi na kuendelea hadi Timna.

es.L: Y gira la frontera desde Baala al occidente hacia el monte Seír, y pasa a la ladera del monte Jearim por el norte, que [es] Quesalón; y baja a Bet-semes, y pasa a Timna.
es.B: Desde Baala la frontera gira al occidente hacia el monte Seír, pasa por la ladera norte del monte Jearim, es decir, Quesalón, baja a Bet-semes y sigue hasta Timna.
es.R: Desde Baala giraba al oeste hacia el monte Seír. Pasaba por el lado norte del monte Jearim, es decir, Quesalón. Luego bajaba a Bet-semes y seguía hasta Timna.

fr.L: Et la frontière tourne depuis Baala vers l’occident, vers le mont Séir, et passe vers le flanc du mont Jearim, au nord, c’[est] Kesalon ; et descend vers Beth-Shémesh, et passe vers Timna.
fr.B: Depuis Baala, la frontière tourne à l’ouest vers le mont Séir, longe le versant nord du mont Jearim, c’est-à-dire Kesalon, puis descend vers Beth-Shémesh et passe vers Timna.
fr.R: Depuis Baala, elle tournait vers l’ouest jusqu’au mont Séir. Elle longeait le côté nord du mont Jearim, c’est-à-dire Kesalon. Puis elle descendait jusqu’à Beth-Shémesh et continuait jusqu’à Timna.

vi.L: Ranh giới vòng từ Ba-a-la về phía tây đến núi Sê-i-rơ, đi qua sườn núi Giê-a-rim ở phía bắc, tức là Kê-sa-lôn; rồi đi xuống Bết-Sê-mết và đi qua Thim-na.
vi.B: Từ Ba-a-la ranh giới vòng về phía tây đến núi Sê-i-rơ, chạy dọc sườn phía bắc núi Giê-a-rim, tức là Kê-sa-lôn, rồi đi xuống Bết-Sê-mết và qua Thim-na.
vi.R: Từ Ba-a-la nó quay về phía tây đến núi Sê-i-rơ. Nó chạy dọc phía bắc núi Giê-a-rim, tức là Kê-sa-lôn. Rồi nó đi xuống Bết-Sê-mết và tiếp đến Thim-na.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 바알라에서 서쪽으로 세일 산으로 돌아가서 여아림 산, 곧 그살론의 북쪽 비탈로 지나가고, 벧세메스로 내려가서 딤나로 지나간다.
ko.B: 경계는 바알라에서 서쪽으로 세일 산을 향해 돌아서 여아림 산, 곧 그살론의 북쪽 비탈을 따라 지나고, 벧세메스로 내려가서 딤나로 지나간다.
ko.R: 바알라에서 경계는 서쪽으로 세일 산까지 돌았다. 그리고 여아림 산, 곧 그살론의 북쪽 비탈을 따라갔다. 그런 다음 벧세메스로 내려가서 딤나까지 갔다.

pt.L: E a fronteira dá a volta desde Baalá, para o oeste, até o monte Seir, e passa pela encosta do monte Jearim, ao norte, que [é] Quesalom; e desce até Bete-Semes, e passa por Timna.
pt.B: De Baalá a fronteira vira para o oeste, até o monte Seir, passa pela encosta norte do monte Jearim, isto é, Quesalom, e depois desce até Bete-Semes e passa por Timna.
pt.R: De Baalá ela virava para o oeste, até o monte Seir. Passava pelo lado norte do monte Jearim, isto é, Quesalom. Depois descia até Bete-Semes e passava por Timna.

decisions.choice: Mount Seir: a ridge west of Kiriath-jearim
decisions.reason: This is a hill on Judah's northern border, not the mountain country of Edom that has the same name (Genesis 36:8).

decisions.choice: Mount Jearim, Chesalon, Beth-shemesh, Timnah
decisions.reason: "That is Chesalon" names the place on the slope of Mount Jearim ("forested mountain"). Beth-shemesh, "house of the sun", is the town where the ark came back from the Philistines (1 Samuel 6:12-15), and Timnah is the town where Samson found his wife (Judges 14:1).

source.text: וְיָצָ֨א הַגְּב֜וּל אֶל־כֶּ֣תֶף עֶקְרוֹן֮ צָפוֹנָה֒ וְתָאַ֤ר הַגְּבוּל֙ שִׁכְּר֔וֹנָה וְעָבַ֥ר הַר־הַֽבַּעֲלָ֖ה וְיָצָ֣א יַבְנְאֵ֑ל וְהָי֛וּ תֹּצְא֥וֹת הַגְּב֖וּל יָֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And goes out the border to [the] slope of Ekron northward, and bends the border [to] Shikkeron, and passes on [to] Mount the Baalah, and goes out [to] Jabneel; and are [the] ends of the border at [the] sea.

en.L: And the border goes out to the slope of Ekron northward, and the border is drawn to Shikkeron, and passes on to Mount Baalah, and goes out to Jabneel; and the end of the border is at the sea.
en.B: The border goes out to the slope north of Ekron, curves around to Shikkeron, passes along to Mount Baalah and goes out to Jabneel. It ends at the sea.
en.R: It went on to the hillside north of Ekron and curved around to Shikkeron. Then it passed Mount Baalah, went on to Jabneel and ended at the Mediterranean Sea.

sw.L: Na mpaka unatokea hadi mteremko wa Ekroni kuelekea kaskazini, na mpaka unazunguka hadi Shikeroni, na kupita hadi mlima Baala, na kutokea Yabneeli; na mwisho wa mpaka ni baharini.
sw.B: Mpaka unatokea kwenye mteremko ulio kaskazini mwa Ekroni, unazunguka hadi Shikeroni, unapita kando ya Mlima Baala na kutokea Yabneeli. Unaishia baharini.
sw.R: Uliendelea hadi kwenye mteremko wa kilima kaskazini mwa Ekroni, ukazunguka hadi Shikeroni. Kisha ukapita Mlima Baala, ukaendelea hadi Yabneeli, ukaishia Bahari ya Mediterania.

es.L: Y sale la frontera a la ladera de Ecrón al norte, y se traza la frontera hacia Sicrón, y pasa al monte Baala, y sale a Jabneel; y los extremos de la frontera están en el mar.
es.B: La frontera sale a la ladera al norte de Ecrón, se curva hacia Sicrón, pasa por el monte Baala y sale a Jabneel. Termina en el mar.
es.R: Seguía hasta la ladera al norte de Ecrón y se curvaba hacia Sicrón. Luego pasaba el monte Baala, seguía hasta Jabneel y terminaba en el mar Mediterráneo.

fr.L: Et la frontière sort vers le flanc d’Ékron, au nord, et la frontière s’infléchit vers Shikkeron, et passe vers le mont Baala, et sort vers Jabnéel ; et les extrémités de la frontière sont à la mer.
fr.B: La frontière sort vers le versant nord d’Ékron, s’incurve vers Shikkeron, passe par le mont Baala et sort vers Jabnéel. Elle aboutit à la mer.
fr.R: Elle allait jusqu’au flanc de la colline, au nord d’Ékron, et tournait vers Shikkeron. Puis elle passait par le mont Baala, allait jusqu’à Jabnéel et se terminait à la mer Méditerranée.

vi.L: Ranh giới đi ra đến sườn Éc-rôn về phía bắc, ranh giới kéo đến Sít-kê-rôn, đi qua núi Ba-a-la, và đi ra đến Giáp-nê-ên; và cuối ranh giới là ở biển.
vi.B: Ranh giới đi ra đến sườn đồi phía bắc Éc-rôn, vòng đến Sít-kê-rôn, chạy qua núi Ba-a-la và ra đến Giáp-nê-ên. Nó dừng lại ở biển.
vi.R: Nó đi tiếp đến sườn đồi phía bắc Éc-rôn và vòng đến Sít-kê-rôn. Rồi nó qua núi Ba-a-la, đến Giáp-nê-ên và dừng lại ở Địa Trung Hải.

ko.L: 그리고 경계는 북쪽으로 에그론 비탈로 나가고, 경계는 식그론으로 이어져 바알라 산으로 지나가서 얍느엘로 나가며, 경계의 끝은 바다이다.
ko.B: 경계는 에그론 북쪽 비탈로 나가서 식그론으로 굽어 돌고, 바알라 산을 지나 얍느엘로 나가서 바다에서 끝난다.
ko.R: 경계는 에그론 북쪽 산비탈로 나가서 식그론 쪽으로 굽어 돌았다. 그리고 바알라 산을 지나 얍느엘까지 가서 지중해에서 끝났다.

pt.L: E a fronteira sai até a encosta de Ecrom, ao norte, e a fronteira se estende até Sicrom, e passa pelo monte Baalá, e sai até Jabneel; e o extremo da fronteira é no mar.
pt.B: A fronteira segue até a encosta ao norte de Ecrom, faz uma curva até Sicrom, passa pelo monte Baalá e segue até Jabneel. Termina no mar.
pt.R: Ela seguia até a encosta ao norte de Ecrom e fazia uma curva até Sicrom. Depois passava pelo monte Baalá, seguia até Jabneel e terminava no mar Mediterrâneo.

decisions.choice: Ekron, Shikkeron, Mount Baalah, Jabneel: the last stretch to the coast
decisions.reason: Ekron was one of the five Philistine cities (13:3). Shikkeron is named only here. Mount Baalah is a ridge near the coast, not the Baalah of verse 9. Jabneel is probably the later Jabneh, near the sea (2 Chronicles 26:6).

decisions.choice: the Mediterranean Sea
decisions.reason: Readable names the sea, as in verse 4.

source.text: וּגְב֣וּל יָ֔ם הַיָּ֥מָּה הַגָּד֖וֹל וּגְב֑וּל זֶ֠ה גְּב֧וּל בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֛ה סָבִ֖יב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] border [of the] west [is] to the sea, the great, and [its] border. This [is the] border of [the] sons of Judah around by their clans.

en.L: And the western border [is] the Great Sea and [its] coast. This [is] the border of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah all around, by their clans.
en.B: The western border is the Great Sea and its coast. These are the borders of the people of Judah on every side, clan by clan.
en.R: On the west, the border was the coast of the Mediterranean Sea. Those were the borders all around the land of the tribe of Judah, for all its clans.

sw.L: Na mpaka wa magharibi [ni] Bahari Kuu na pwani [yake]. Huu [ndio] mpaka wa wana wa Yuda pande zote, kufuatana na koo zao.
sw.B: Mpaka wa magharibi ni Bahari Kuu na pwani yake. Hii ndiyo mipaka ya watu wa Yuda pande zote, ukoo kwa ukoo.
sw.R: Upande wa magharibi, mpaka ulikuwa pwani ya Bahari ya Mediterania. Hiyo ndiyo iliyokuwa mipaka ya nchi ya kabila la Yuda pande zote, kwa koo zake zote.

es.L: Y la frontera del occidente [es] el mar Grande y [su] costa. Esta [es] la frontera de los hijos de Judá alrededor, conforme a sus clanes.
es.B: La frontera occidental es el mar Grande y su costa. Estas son las fronteras de la gente de Judá por todos lados, clan por clan.
es.R: Por el oeste, la frontera era la costa del mar Mediterráneo. Esas eran las fronteras alrededor de la tierra de la tribu de Judá, para todos sus clanes.

fr.L: Et la frontière de l’occident [est] la Grande Mer et [son] rivage. Ceci [est] la frontière des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda tout autour, selon leurs clans.
fr.B: La frontière ouest est la Grande Mer et son rivage. Telles sont les frontières qui entourent le territoire des gens de Juda, clan par clan.
fr.R: À l’ouest, la frontière était la côte de la mer Méditerranée. C’étaient les frontières tout autour du pays de la tribu de Juda, pour tous ses clans.

vi.L: Ranh giới phía tây [là] Biển Lớn và bờ [của nó]. Đây [là] ranh giới chung quanh của con cháu Giu-đa theo các gia tộc của họ.
vi.B: Ranh giới phía tây là Biển Lớn và bờ biển. Đó là ranh giới bốn phía của người Giu-đa, theo từng gia tộc.
vi.R: Ở phía tây, ranh giới là bờ Địa Trung Hải. Đó là ranh giới bốn phía của đất chi tộc Giu-đa, cho tất cả các gia tộc của chi tộc ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 서쪽 경계는 대해와 [그] 해안이다. 이것이 유다 자손의 그들의 종족대로의 사방 경계이다.
ko.B: 서쪽 경계는 대해와 그 해안이다. 이것이 유다 자손이 종족별로 받은 땅의 사방 경계이다.
ko.R: 서쪽 경계는 지중해 바닷가였다. 이것이 유다 지파의 모든 집안이 받은 땅의 사방 경계이다.

pt.L: E a fronteira ocidental [era] o Grande Mar e [a sua] costa. Esta [é] a fronteira dos filhos de Judá ao redor, segundo os seus clãs.
pt.B: A fronteira ocidental é o Grande Mar e a sua costa. Essas são as fronteiras do povo de Judá de todos os lados, clã por clã.
pt.R: No oeste, a fronteira era a costa do mar Mediterrâneo. Essas eram as fronteiras de todos os lados da terra da tribo de Judá, para todos os seus clãs.

decisions.choice: the Great Sea and its coast: the Mediterranean shore
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:6: the sea itself, with its coastline, is the western border.

decisions.choice: this is the border all around: the summary that closes the description
decisions.reason: The words answer verse 1: the land inside the four lines, south (verses 2-4), east (verse 5), north (verses 5-11) and west (verse 12), is the share of Judah's clans.

decisions.choice: the people of Judah (B); the tribe of Judah (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "children of Judah". Balanced and Readable name the people as a tribe; the Hebrew phrase means the descendants of Judah, men and women.

decisions.choice: the Mediterranean Sea
decisions.reason: As in Numbers 34:6.

decisions.choice: "el mar Grande" (L, B); "el mar Mediterráneo" (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name, "the Great Sea"; Readable names it as Spanish readers know it, as the English Readable does. Balanced "la gente de Judá" as the English "the people of Judah", with no gender span: "gente" already takes in everyone.

decisions.choice: "la Grande Mer" (L, B), "la mer Méditerranée" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name, Readable gives the modern one.

decisions.choice: "대해" (L, B); "지중해" (R) for the Great Sea
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew name, "the Great Sea"; Readable names the Mediterranean (meaning decision m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "Biển Lớn" (Literal, Balanced); "Địa Trung Hải" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Great Sea is the Mediterranean; Readable gives the name a reader knows today, as the English does.

source.text: וּלְכָלֵ֣ב בֶּן־יְפֻנֶּ֗ה נָ֤תַן חֵ֨לֶק֙ בְּת֣וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־יְהוּדָ֔ה אֶל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לִֽיהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־קִרְיַ֥ת אַרְבַּ֛ע אֲבִ֥י הָעֲנָ֖ק הִ֥יא חֶבְרֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And to Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a portion in [the] midst of [the] sons of Judah, according to [the] mouth of Yahweh to Joshua: Kiriath-arba, the father of the Anak, that [is] Hebron.

en.L: And to Caleb son of Jephunneh he gave a portion among the {{gender:children|sons}} of Judah, according to the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to Joshua: Kiriath-arba, [Arba being] the father of Anak, that [is] Hebron.
en.B: Caleb son of Jephunneh was given a share among the people of Judah, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Joshua. It was Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron. Arba was the father of Anak.
en.R: As {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Joshua, Caleb son of Jephunneh was given a share of land among the people of Judah. He received Kiriath-arba, also called Hebron. Arba had been the father of Anak.

sw.L: Na Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alimpa fungu katikati ya wana wa Yuda, kufuatana na kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa Yoshua: Kiriath-arba, [Arba akiwa] baba wa Anaki, yaani Hebroni.
sw.B: Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alipewa fungu kati ya watu wa Yuda, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amemwamuru Yoshua. Fungu hilo lilikuwa Kiriath-arba, yaani Hebroni. Arba alikuwa baba wa Anaki.
sw.R: Kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyokuwa amemwamuru Yoshua, Kalebu mwana wa Yefune alipewa fungu la nchi kati ya watu wa Yuda. Alipokea Kiriath-arba, ambao pia huitwa Hebroni. Arba alikuwa baba wa Anaki.

es.L: Y a Caleb hijo de Jefone le dio una parte en medio de los hijos de Judá, conforme a la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a Josué: Quiriat-arbá, [Arbá era] el padre de Anac, que [es] Hebrón.
es.B: A Caleb hijo de Jefone se le dio una parte entre la gente de Judá, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Josué. Fue Quiriat-arbá, es decir, Hebrón. Arbá era el padre de Anac.
es.R: Tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Josué, a Caleb hijo de Jefone se le dio una parte de la tierra entre la gente de Judá. Recibió Quiriat-arbá, que también se llama Hebrón. Arbá había sido el padre de Anac.

fr.L: Et à Caleb, fils de Jephounné, il donna une part au milieu des {{gender:enfants|fils}} de Juda, selon la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} à Josué : Kiryath-Arba, [Arba étant] le père d’Anaq, c’[est] Hébron.
fr.B: Caleb, fils de Jephounné, reçut une part au milieu des gens de Juda, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Josué : c’était Kiryath-Arba, c’est-à-dire Hébron. Arba était le père d’Anaq.
fr.R: Comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Josué, Caleb, fils de Jephounné, a reçu une part du pays au milieu des gens de Juda. Il a reçu Kiryath-Arba, qu’on appelle aussi Hébron. Arba avait été le père d’Anaq.

vi.L: Còn Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê, ông ban cho một phần giữa con cháu Giu-đa, theo miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [truyền] cho Giô-suê: Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba, [A-ra-ba là] cha của A-nác, tức là Hếp-rôn.
vi.B: Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê được ban một phần giữa người Giu-đa, như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Giô-suê. Đó là Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba, tức là Hếp-rôn. A-ra-ba là cha của A-nác.
vi.R: Như {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã truyền cho Giô-suê, Ca-lép con trai Giê-phu-nê được ban một phần đất giữa người Giu-đa. Ông nhận Ki-ri-át A-ra-ba, cũng gọi là Hếp-rôn. A-ra-ba từng là cha của A-nác.

ko.L: 그리고 여분네의 아들 갈렙에게는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 하신 명령대로 유다 자손 가운데서 몫을 주었으니, 아낙의 아버지 [아르바의 성읍인] 기럇 아르바, 곧 헤브론이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 명령하신 대로, 여분네의 아들 갈렙은 유다 자손 가운데서 몫을 받았다. 그것은 기럇 아르바, 곧 헤브론이다. 아르바는 아낙의 아버지였다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여호수아에게 명령하신 대로, 여분네의 아들 갈렙은 유다 자손 가운데서 자기 몫의 땅을 받았다. 그는 헤브론이라고도 하는 기럇 아르바를 받았다. 아르바는 아낙의 아버지였다.

pt.L: E a Calebe, filho de Jefoné, deu uma porção no meio dos filhos de Judá, segundo a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} a Josué: Quiriate-Arba, [sendo Arba] o pai de Anaque, que [é] Hebrom.
pt.B: Calebe, filho de Jefoné, recebeu uma parte no meio do povo de Judá, como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ordenado a Josué. Foi Quiriate-Arba, isto é, Hebrom. Arba era o pai de Anaque.
pt.R: Como {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha ordenado a Josué, Calebe, filho de Jefoné, recebeu uma parte da terra no meio do povo de Judá. Ele recebeu Quiriate-Arba, também chamada Hebrom. Arba tinha sido o pai de Anaque.

decisions.choice: he gave: Joshua, though the Hebrew leaves the giver unnamed
decisions.reason: The verb has no stated subject. In 14:13 Joshua is the one who gives Hebron to Caleb, and here he acts on the LORD's command to him, so Joshua is meant.

decisions.choice: according to the mouth of the LORD: as the LORD commanded
decisions.reason: A command is said to come from someone's "mouth". The LORD had promised Caleb the land he walked on, because he followed the LORD fully (Numbers 14:24; Deuteronomy 1:36; Joshua 14:6-14).

decisions.choice: Kiriath-arba, the father of Anak: the town of Arba, ancestor of the Anakim
decisions.reason: Kiriath-arba means "town of Arba". Arba was the greatest man among the Anakim (14:15) and the father of Anak, from whom the Anakim were named. The town's later name was Hebron.

decisions.choice: was given
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use a passive so as not to name a giver the Hebrew does not name (m1).

decisions.choice: [Arba being]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets "the father of Anak" right after the town's name, meaning Arba. Literal supplies the name in brackets so the words are not read as describing the town.

decisions.choice: the mouth of
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture (m2); Balanced and Readable say "had commanded".

decisions.choice: "주께서 여호수아에게 하신 명령대로"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "according to the mouth of the LORD"; Korean "입대로" does not carry the idiom, so even Literal says "command", as meaning decision m2 reads it.

decisions.choice: Calebe, filho de Jefoné; Quiriate-Arba, Hebrom; Anaque
decisions.reason: The names keep the Portuguese of the Pentateuch: "Calebe, filho de Jefoné" (Numbers 34:19), "Quiriate-Arba" and "Hebrom" (Genesis 23:2), and "Anaque" for the ancestor (Numbers 13:22), whose people are "os anaquins" (11:21).

decisions.choice: Calebe ... recebeu
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name the giver (m1), and the English says "was given" (r-en-1). Portuguese says the same with Caleb as subject of "receber", which reads more naturally than a passive with the subject after it.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤רֶשׁ מִשָּׁם֙ כָּלֵ֔ב אֶת־שְׁלוֹשָׁ֖ה בְּנֵ֣י הָעֲנָ֑ק אֶת־שֵׁשַׁ֤י וְאֶת־אֲחִימַן֙ וְאֶת־תַּלְמַ֔י יְלִידֵ֖י הָעֲנָֽק׃

ko.L: 그리고 갈렙이 거기에서 아낙의 세 아들, 곧 아낙의 자손인 세새와 아히만과 달매를 쫓아냈다.

ko.R: 갈렙은 거기에서 아낙의 세 아들을 쫓아냈다. 그들의 이름은 세새와 아히만과 달매였는데, 아낙 집안 사람들이었다.

pt.B: Calebe expulsou dali os três filhos de Anaque, Sesai, Aimã e Talmai, os descendentes de Anaque.
pt.R: Calebe expulsou dali os três filhos de Anaque. Eles se chamavam Sesai, Aimã e Talmai e eram da família de Anaque.

decisions.choice: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai: the men the scouts saw at Hebron
decisions.reason: The same three were living at Hebron when the scouts came there forty-five years before (Numbers 13:22, 28, 33); their size had frightened the people. "Sons" and "descendants" may mean clans as well as men. Judges 1:10 tells of Judah defeating them.

decisions.choice: dispossessed: took the land from them
decisions.reason: The verb means to take possession by driving out those who held it, as the LORD promised (Deuteronomy 9:2-3).

decisions.choice: desapossou (L); expulsou (B, R); Sesai, Aimã, Talmai; os nascidos de Anaque (L)
decisions.reason: For chapters 15-17: the verb of taking land by driving out its people (m2) is "desapossar" at Literal and "expulsar" at Balanced and Readable, as Deuteronomy 9:1 and 9:3 have it in Portuguese. The three names, and "os nascidos de Anaque" at Literal, keep the Portuguese of Numbers 13:22, in this verse's order.

en.R: From there he went to attack the people of Debir. Debir's old name was Kiriath-sepher.

vi.R: Từ đó ông đi đánh dân thành Đê-bia. Tên cũ của Đê-bia là Ki-ri-át Sê-phe.

pt.R: Dali ele foi atacar o povo de Debir. O nome antigo de Debir era Quiriate-Sefer.

decisions.choice: Debir, once Kiriath-sepher: a town in the hills south-west of Hebron
decisions.reason: Joshua had struck Debir before (10:38-39), but it had to be taken again. Kiriath-sepher means "town of the book" or "town of the scribe"; verse 49 gives a third name, Kiriath-sannah.

decisions.choice: the story told again in Judges 1:11-15
decisions.reason: Verses 15-19 are repeated almost word for word in Judges 1:11-15, where the attack is part of Judah's campaign after Joshua's death.

vi.R: Ca-lép nói: "Ai tấn công và chiếm được Ki-ri-át Sê-phe, ta sẽ gả con gái ta là Ạc-sa cho người ấy."

ko.B: 갈렙이 말했다. "기럇 세벨을 쳐서 차지하는 사람에게 내 딸 악사를 아내로 주겠다."
ko.R: 갈렙이 말했다. "기럇 세벨을 쳐서 그 성읍을 차지하는 사람에게 내 딸 악사를 아내로 주겠다."

pt.L: E Calebe disse: "Quem ferir Quiriate-Sefer e a tomar, eu lhe darei Acsa, minha filha, por mulher."
pt.B: Calebe disse: "Ao homem que atacar Quiriate-Sefer e a conquistar, eu darei a minha filha Acsa como esposa."
pt.R: Calebe disse: "Vou dar a minha filha Acsa como esposa ao homem que atacar Quiriate-Sefer e conquistar a cidade."

decisions.choice: I will give him my daughter as a wife: a bride as the reward for a deed of war
decisions.reason: A father arranged his daughter's marriage. Offering her to the man who won a hard battle honored the winner and bound him to the family, as Saul's offer for killing Goliath did (1 Samuel 17:25; 18:17).

decisions.choice: strikes: attacks
decisions.reason: The verb means to strike or attack; with "captures it" it means to attack the town and take it.

decisions.choice: Caleb, the leader, says "ta" before his men
decisions.reason: A chief making a public promise to his fighting men speaks with authority.

decisions.choice: ferir (L), atacar (B, R); Acsa; por mulher (L), como esposa (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Acsa" is the usual Brazilian form of the name. Literal keeps "ferir", the verb's first sense of striking (m2), and "por mulher", the old phrase for giving a daughter in marriage; Balanced and Readable say "atacar" and "como esposa". Judges 1:12-15 tells the same story and should keep these words in Portuguese.

source.text: וַֽיִּלְכְּדָ֛הּ עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־קְנַ֖ז אֲחִ֣י כָלֵ֑ב וַיִּתֶּן־ל֛וֹ אֶת־עַכְסָ֥ה בִתּ֖וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃

en.B: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, captured it, so Caleb gave him his daughter Achsah as his wife.

sw.R: Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu wa Kalebu, aliuteka mji huo. Kwa hiyo Kalebu akampa binti yake Aksa awe mke wake.

es.B: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, hermano de Caleb, la tomó, y Caleb le dio por esposa a su hija Acsa.
es.R: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, hermano de Caleb, conquistó el pueblo. Así que Caleb le dio a su hija Acsa para que fuera su esposa.
